PUBLIC COMMENTS
The public is encouraged to address the City Council or any of its Agencies listed on this agenda on any matter posted on the agenda or on any other matter within its jurisdiction. If you wish to address the City Council or any of its Agencies, you may do so during the PUBLIC COMMUNICATIONS period noted on the agenda. Each person is allowed three (3) minutes speaking time. A Spanish speaking interpreter is available for your convenience.
COMENTARIOS DEL PUBLICO
Se invita al público a dirigirse al Concilio o cualquiera otra de sus Agencias nombradas en esta agenda, para hablar sobre cualquier asunto publicado en la agenda o cualquier tema que esté bajo su jurisdicción. Si usted desea la oportunidad de dirigirse al Concilio o alguna de sus Agencias, podrá hacerlo durante el período de Comentarios del Público (Public Communications) anunciado en la agenda. A cada persona se le permite hablar por tres (3) minutos. Hay un intérprete para su conveniencia.
Any written public record relating to an agenda item for an open session of a regular meeting of the City Council that is distributed to the City Council less than 72 hours prior to that meeting will be available for public inspection at City Hall in the City Clerk's office at 14403 E. Pacific Avenue, 3rd Floor during normal business hours (Monday - Thursday, 7:30 a.m. - 6:00 p.m.)

ANNOUNCEMENTS
PROCLAMATIONS, COMMENDATIONS & PRESENTATIONS
• Presentation of Certificate of Recognition to Oscar Cristerna Jr. for Best Deaf Artist in the City of Los Angeles for the Henry P. Rio Bridge Gallery at the 4th Annual Disability Art Exhibit
• Presentation of findings by Cyclertopia and the teens of the Cycler Leadership Program
PUBLIC COMMUNICATIONS
CONSENT CALENDAR
1.
WARRANTS AND DEMANDS
Staff recommends City Council receive and file.
STAFF REPORT
2.
PROPOSED RECOGNITIONS BY THE MAYOR AND CITY COUNCIL
Staff recommends City Council approve the preparation and presentation of the plaques, proclamations and certificates as outlined in the staff report.
STAFF REPORT
3.
CLAIM REJECTION
Staff recommends City Council reject the claims of Henry Gutierrez, Victor Salaiza, Henry Garcia, Ramiro Espejo Leon, and Ana Estrada and direct staff to send the appropriate notice of rejection to claimants.
STAFF REPORT
4.
MONTHLY FINANCIAL REPORT: OCTOBER 2011
Staff recommends that the City Council receive and file the monthly financial report for the period ended October 31, 2011.
STAFF REPORT
5.
TREASURER'S REPORT: OCTOBER 2011
Staff recommends that the City Council receive and file the October 2011 Treasurer's Report. (See Item #1 on the Finance Authority Agenda, Item #1 on the Community Development Commission Agenda and Item #2 on the Housing Authority Agenda)
STAFF REPORT
6.
FUND BALANCE AND CLASSIFICATION POLICY
Staff recommends that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 2011-049, which establishes the Fund Balance Policy, Classifications and maintains General Fund Reserves a ten percent.
STAFF REPORT
7.
UNPAID VENDOR DEBT - KNIGHT COMMUNICATIONS INC.
Staff recommends City Council approve payment of the 2005 Knight Communications Inc. invoices out of the Police Department's Asset Forfeiture Funds in the amount of $20,300.00
STAFF REPORT
8.
BID RESULTS, CONSTRUCTION OF THE BALDWIN PARK TRANSIT CENTER
Staff recommends City Council (1) reject all bids; (2) Authorize staff o revise the bid sheets to establish a new lower base bid by separating from the base work the following components as alternative bids: cast concrete vs precast concrete, steel w/powder coating vs. alloy metals, stainless steel vs. aluminum, stamped/colored concrete vs pavers, no video cameras vs video option, exposed exterior vs exterior paint, base signage vs all signage, standard labor agreement vs PLA; (3) Authorize staff to rebid the project using the revised bid sheets, and open bids tentatively on January 16, 2012.
STAFF REPORT
SET MATTERS - PUBLIC HEARINGS
9.
A REQUEST FOR CONSIDERATION TO MODIFY CONDITION (X) OF CITY COUNCIL RESOLUTION 2011-007 BY CHANGING THE DENSITY BONUS CRITERIA TO ALLOW FOR ONE (1) VERY LOW INCOME DENSITY BONUS DWELLING UNIT INSTEAD OF TWO (2) LOW INCOME DENSITY BONUS DWELLING UNITS WITHIN A SINGLE-FAMILY RESIDENTIAL PROJECT (LOCATION: 3346-3354 VINELAND AVENUE; APPLICANT: DAVID COOK, REPRESENTING DC CORPORATION; CASE NUMBER: CP-785MOD)
Staff recommends that following the public hearing and receiving public comment, the City Council approve the request to modify condition (X) on Resolution 2011-007, entitled, "A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF BALDWIN PARK AMENDING CITY COUNCIL RESOLUTION 2011-007 BY MODIFYING THE DENSITY BONUS CRITERIA STATED IN THE CONDITION X TO ALLOW FOR ONE (1) VERY LOW INCOME UNIT (LOCATION: 3346-3354 VINELAND AVENUE; APPLICANT: DAVID COOK, REPRESENTING DC CORPORATION; CASE NUMBER: CP-785MOD)."
STAFF REPORT

REVIEW OF COMMISSION APPLICANTS AND CONSIDERATION OF APPOINTMENTS AND/OR REAPPOINTMENTS TO FILL THE JUNE 30, 2011 SCHEDULED VACANCIES
Staff recommends City Council review all Commission applications and provide direction to staff.

Staff recommends City Council review all Commission applications and provide direction to staff.

CITY COUNCIL / CITY CLERK / CITY TREASURER / STAFF REQUESTS & COMMUNICATIONS
Request by Councilmember Ricardo Pacheco for discussion & direction to staff on the following:
• To exempt the property at 13404 Waco Street from the conditions of the current zoning code to allow the owner to use the property to store and repair buses
• To review the Sign Ordinance and evaluate its effectiveness, fees and fines
